prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A striking adult Brazilian woman — Brazilian poised refined beauty with golden-honey tan skin and real visible pores, early 20s, a polished low bun with a few loose strands, both ears visible, a full makeup: a luminous base, long lashes, a soft blush and a glossy pink-nude lip, real wyvern eyes: large glossy deep violet irises with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, jet black, running the full height of each eye, a faint paler violet ring around the pupil, both eyes the same, the colour solidly saturated across the whole iris with a darker ring around its edge, a wet glassy shine on the surface of each eye, set in her ordinary human eyelids and sitting clear of the eyelid edges, a smug, amused smirk — a photograph of a real Brazilian woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her face is natural and beautiful: a soft round face with full cheeks, a small nose with a soft tip and a defined cupid's bow. Face irezumi: a traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo in bold black ink outlines with vivid colour fills covers her forehead: a wyvern in slate grey and rust orange with black-edged scales, its wings spread and its barbed tail curled, storm clouds and lightning around it, its body winding across the whole forehead from one temple to the other, its head raised at the centre of the forehead above the brows; it is real tattooed skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible through the ink, the piercings, henna and stickers sit on top of the inked skin wherever they overlap, and her eyes, eyelids and lips stay bare real skin. Eyeshadow: her eyeshadow is a snake-scale makeup in slate grey, steel blue and rust orange, a smooth gradient across the whole eyelid from the lash line up to the brow bone, with a sharp, narrow, upswept winged liner in a black-slate that ends in a long fine point at the outer corner and a faint shimmer of tiny scale-like glitter on the outer third of the lid; it sits on the lids as ordinary eyeshadow on her real skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible, and the eyeballs and lashes stay natural. Her brows are bare like the Mona Lisa's: the whole brow bone is smooth, hairless skin in the same tone as her forehead, with only the soft natural curve of the brow ridge showing, her forehead high, smooth and serene. Her lips are slightly parted and a real snake's tongue slides out through the gap between them and extends far out: an extremely thin, round, smooth cord as slim as a shoelace from its base to its tips, split from the tips back almost to its base into two hair-fine, needle-sharp prongs, each as fine as a thick strand of hair, held in a narrow V in the air and hanging well past her chin down to the base of her throat, bright scarlet red, glossy and wet-looking like a real snake's tongue, the whole thin tongue clearly visible against her skin and in sharp focus. Her lips part wide enough to show two long, slender, curved venomous fangs that descend from her upper jaw on either side of the centre, ivory-white with a glossy wet sheen, each as long as her lower lip is tall and tapering to a needle-sharp point, in sharp focus beside the thin tongue (this overrides the lips pressed or closed in her expression). Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with one or two small natural beauty marks, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, real wet catchlights in the eyes and individual hair strands catching the light. Her shoulders, collarbones and upper chest are real living skin too, with visible pores, fine skin grain, faint peach-fuzz and a soft natural sheen of skin oils, her skin tone varying naturally across the collarbones and shoulders. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): 'cherry lips': the fullness concentrated in the centre of the upper and lower lips, forming a rounded, plump, pouty cherry-shaped mouth with the corners left slim and untouched, glossy cherry-red, youthful, sweet and symmetrical; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a soft, round 'baby face' jaw: full, plump, rounded cheeks, a short, soft, rounded jawline with no sharp angles and a small, round, slightly full chin. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about seventy-three in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; two small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two straight bars across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit fourteen pieces above the lobe: seven classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, four studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and three in the conch and tragus; ten small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; five small studs on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; eight small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of this iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly eight separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear dull dark brass a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a shortest chain, blackened cast iron a teardrop-shaped sinker on a shortest chain, dull pewter-grey tin a square-sided cowbell on a short chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a cube-shaped block on a medium chain, oxidized dark copper a ship's anchor on a long chain, tarnished dark silver a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a long chain, dull blue-grey lead a miniature anvil on a longer chain, dark patinated bronze a round bell on a longest chain; on the right ear oxidized dark copper a pyramid-shaped lump on a shortest chain, blackened cast iron a hammer head on a shortest chain, dull pewter-grey tin a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a short chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a square-sided cowbell on a medium chain, dull dark brass a cube-shaped block on a long chain, dull blue-grey lead a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, tarnished dark silver a miniature anvil on a longer chain, dark patinated bronze a ship's anchor on a longest chain. On each ear the single iron ring carries all the weights, hanging in a staggered cluster on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because all the load is carried by one opening, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: The background is a misty forest at dusk, soft blurred dark-green trees fading into pale fog, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than her face so that her face and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
